definitions.explanation: An official form submitted to the local ward or city office when moving to a different municipality in Japan.

examples.japanese: {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}を{出|だ}してきた。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{前|まえ}に{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A moving-out notification is required before moving.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}で{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}の{手続|てつづ}きをする。
examples.english: I'll complete the moving-out notification procedures at the city hall.

notes:
{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ} is filed at your current municipality's office when moving to a different city, ward, or town. You receive a {転出|てんしゅつ}{証明書|しょうめいしょ} (moving-out certificate) which you then submit along with {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ} at your new location.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (to submit a moving-out notification)
- {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}の{届出|とどけで} (filing a moving-out notification)

RELATED TERMS:
- {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}: moving-in notification
- {転居届|てんきょとどけ}: change of address notice
- {住民票|じゅうみんひょう}: certificate of residence
